hook_text: From the side it is a mug. From above it is just a circle. Same mug, different view.
clip_script: A Grade 4 classroom in George. Put a mug on the table and crouch down: you see its side, with a handle. Now stand on a chair and look straight down: a circle with a little bump. That is a plan view, the view a bird would have. A hat from above: two circles. A shoe: a long rounded shape. A classroom from above: rectangles for desks. Every map is drawn as a plan view.
visual_style: Whiteboard objects drawn twice, first from the side and then from directly above, with a little bird flying over each one.
mood: Playful puzzle, like a guessing game.
pacing: Show the side view, flip to the plan view, guess the object, then build up to a classroom.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the plan view of your desk.
